A '''heart transplant''' was a medical procedure in which a patient's failing [[Heart/Legends|heart]] was removed and the replaced with a healthy heart. [[N'do Maetrecis]], a soldier fighting for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], was badly wounded by shrapnel on [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] and needed a heart transplant.
